flags.summary: The party told Kasimir at the Vistani camp that Patrina was laid to rest without him ("she's done waiting"; allies/kasimir:rest_told). He puts the net down for good. Set only at the camp: when he stood before her himself the temple sets kasimir_at_peace instead, and the epilogue reads both (Story Allies Presence Plan, package K1).
The party told Kasimir at the Vistani camp that Patrina's spirit was destroyed, and he asked only whether she was afraid (allies/kasimir:destroyed_told). Sets kasimir_cold.

Kasimir's warmth toward the party is gone, after he heard the party destroyed his sister. His camp greeting and hub opening turn curt, and his scrolls cost a quarter more (price_flags in data/npcs/kasimir_velikov.json). Nothing else changes: his hub still answers, and the story never depends on him.

Kasimir, walking with the party after Patrina was laid to rest, has asked whether to go back to the camp, and the party answered go home or stay (allies/kasimir:homeward). Asked once; a "later" answer leaves it unset.
Kasimir's hub told the party what the Vistani say about how Vallaki's festival ended (allies/kasimir:t_festival_*; only at the camp, where he hears the news).
Kasimir's hub told the party how the camp took Arabelle's return or loss (allies/kasimir:t_arabelle_*; only at the camp).
Kasimir's hub told the party what the camp says of Bluto's end (allies/kasimir:t_bluto_*; only at the camp).
Kasimir read the Tome of Strahd's page on the dusk elves with the party and looked for Patrina's name (allies/kasimir:t_tome).
Kasimir told the party what a dark gift costs and how it shows on the one who took it (allies/kasimir:t_gift).
Kasimir spoke of Tarakamedes, the dragon in the red amber: a warning before the party has heard it, a quiet word after (allies/kasimir:t_dragon_*).
Kasimir spoke of Master Vosk, the scholar of the temple: a warning before the party has met him, a dry word after (allies/kasimir:t_broker_*).
